name: RDomino
summary:
RDomino is a real-time multiplayer dominoes game played by Dominican partnership rules. Four players sit around a 3D table, partners facing each other, two against two, playing a series of rounds to 200 points. It implements the full Dominican ruleset, including the opening double, capicúa, passing, blocked hands (tranque) and the count that settles them, with an authoritative server validating every move.

Players can be matched with strangers in seconds, invite a friend to sit as their partner, host a private table with their own rules, or practice against bots. The board is fully 3D: tiles are washed, drawn and slammed with sound, and matches carry voice chat, emotes and a Nosotros / Ellos scoreboard. Tables, tile sets, nameplates and avatars are collectible. RDomino is free to play in a browser and as an iOS and Android app.
